candidate_wall_seconds.aggregation_warning: sum is accumulated candidate elapsed time; overlapping workers mean it is not actual stage wall time
candidate_wall_seconds.unit: candidate executor elapsed seconds including sandbox startup and all test processes

case_seconds.timeout_seconds_semantics: timeout records contain the configured per-test budget, not measured completion time
case_seconds.unit: seconds recorded in the program child; not sandbox or stage wall time

limitations: AST imports include conditional and function-local declarations, whether reached or not.
Dynamic imports, alias-based import calls and runtime module availability are not resolved.
Relative imports are separately flagged and are not classified as absolute top modules.
No candidate source, generated assertions, exception details or hidden inputs are included.
No candidate execution or dependency import is performed by this audit.
scope: all frozen visible-execution candidates; no hidden labels read or exclusions applied
stdlib_classification: top module membership in Python 3.11 sys.stdlib_module_names; not an importability test
